answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. Claiming one slot burns 100 credits, twice 30-day earnings, for a juniper agent, never refunded. A slot lasts 20 epochs; renewal needs a fresh burn, fraud revokes it without refund. An attacker making 100 identities on an island market must burn 10,000 credits, while a lotus trader pays 100 once. Honest agents pay once and share rewards only with burned-slot holders, so earnings are not diluted.
